what: ArcelorMittal is one of the world's largest steelmakers, with plants across Europe, North and South America, Africa and India, and its own iron ore mines. It makes everything from car body steel to construction beams.
customers: Carmakers, construction companies, appliance and machinery manufacturers, and energy companies.
money: flat and long steel products across several countries
steel for the US and Mexican markets
Brazilian steel and its own iron ore supply
moat: Owning iron ore mines alongside the mills, so it is less exposed to raw material prices than steelmakers that buy everything.
risks: European steel demand has been weak and energy costs there are high
Chinese steel exports depress world prices
Net margin of about 5% reflects an industry with little pricing power
Carbon regulation in Europe requires expensive plant conversions
opportunities: European trade measures against imported steel would support prices
The Indian joint venture is expanding in a fast-growing market
Analysts see about 27% upside from current levels
watch: European steel spreads and Chinese export volumes.
